Wiktionary Lookup

Offline dictionary for every language in English Wiktionary (via kaikki.org, CC BY-SA 4.0): Chinese built in, 467 languages downloadable in the app. Incremental search by headword, romanization or English.

Currently it serves 1 apps. To add it to your F-Droid app, scan the QR code (click it to enlarge) or use this link:

https://d33mobile.github.io/wiktionary-lookup-fdroid/repo
